title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
reason: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with native 15-second video generation and editing capabilities.

sources.summary: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings native 15-second video generation and editing, stronger consistency, and 30% lower pricing.

title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
reason: Zcash implements the NU7 upgrade, significantly speeding up private payments and reducing work.

sources.summary: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.
